title: Treat /content and the runtime filesystem as ephemeral
summary: Results that matter must be downloaded or otherwise materialized into a durable controller-owned artifact before the session is stopped. The remote /content workspace is convenient working storage, not the authoritative result repository. Preserve exact manifests/digests for returned artifacts and verify them locally before promotion.
evidence_note: Current upstream uses /content as the normal runtime working directory and documents explicit upload/download operations. Live recovery jobs returned tarred artifact sets with manifests before cleanup.
invariants: Never make post-stop correctness depend on a remote temporary path.
Verify downloaded output identity before accepting/publishing it.
